top_story: Israel’s 28 October election aftermath has hardened into a legitimacy crisis for Benjamin Netanyahu, whose path to staying in office now depends less on a clear mandate than on whether rivals can assemble a blocking coalition that includes or relies on Palestinian Israeli parties.
